subject: Archer onboarding: credential stamping & KMS-signed evidence request
messages:
From: Julie Cohen <julie.cohen@archer.io>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: archer-security-portal@archer.io
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding - shortproof + KMS signature ask

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. To progress our vendor onboarding for Archer's Q3 intake we need two small items to attach to the OneTrust profile: 1) a KMS-signed manifest proving possession of the SOC2 encryption keys (or a signed hash of the artifact), and 2) an example ephemeral service credential and TTL policy so our infra team can validate your temp-credential workflow.

If you can drop those into the portal (or send presigned links) we can complete our SIG/CAIQ mapping and move to a short technical review. Preferably we get the artifacts by EOD Monday (Aug 31).

Thanks,
Julie Cohen\Security Review Lead\Archer

---

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
To: Julie Cohen <julie.cohen@archer.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding - shortproof + KMS signature ask

Hi Julie —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers / plan:
- We can produce a KMS-signed manifest containing a SHA256 hash of the artifact and sign it with our KMS signing key. That will include timestamp and key id.
- We'll generate a sample ephemeral credential (STS-style) with a 1-hour TTL and an example issuance audit log snippet.

Rishi (cc'd) will prepare the artifacts and upload a presigned bundle to S3. Kimberly will coordinate the OneTrust/Whistic upload and share the portal record id.

Target: upload by Mon 2026-08-31 17:00 PT. If Archer needs an earlier handoff for any live tests we can prioritize.

Best,
Maya\Sr. Security Ops\Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Julie Cohen <julie.cohen@archer.io>, maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood onboarding - shortproof + KMS signature ask

Julie / team —

Uploading the artifacts now. Summary of items attached to presign:
- redwood_kms_manifest.json.sig -> JSON manifest (sha256) signed by KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01 and timestamped 2026-08-31T15:12:00Z
- ephemeral-cred-sample.txt -> sample STS token format with TTL field (redacted secret values) and issuance audit entry
- archers_qna_export.csv -> mapping file with the CAIQ question IDs we answered (for your portal import)

Presigned URL: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/archer/presign/20260831-manifest.sig (expires 72h)

Note: redwood_kms_manifest.json.sig is a detached signature file. If Archer requires a signed envelope or a different signature algorithm (e.g., RSA-PSS) let us know and we'll reissue.

Thanks,
Rishi\Infra Security\Redwood

Hi Rishi / Maya —

Received the presigned bundle and validated the signature format against our intake script. Everything looks good; portal upload completed and QNA imported. A couple of tiny follow-ups before we close the intake:

- Could you add the signing key rotation schedule (cron/interval) to the manifest metadata? We need an expected rotation window.
- For the ephemeral token sample, can you include the caller identity field (redacted) and the specific TTL enforcement S3 policy snippet you use for token revocation?

Once we get those two short items we'll mark the OneTrust profile as "proofed" and proceed to the SIG correlation stage. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Julie\Security Review Lead\Archer
